We have reached agreement on a significant amount of evidence that is on the Randall master list. The Defence is considering other schedules that we submitted last night. It is our except ation that we will achieve significant progress in resolving the exhibits on the Randall master list, although Mr. Randall will be required to testify in our view today for part of the day, and we would request that he be permitted to testify on Tuesday, to conclude his evidence, because what remains in work for the parties on the schedules that are under consideration and discussion is considerable; and we're trying to abbreviate as much of the presentation as we can through the presentation of schedules. Part of the work that is required in the ongoing discussions is to resolve whether those should remain marked for identification.
